introHtml: SRCG bistro mugs combine durable ceramic construction with classic styling, making them a favorite for coffee shops, corporate breakrooms, and promotional giveaways. These mugs feature a comfortable handle and generous capacity, ideal for hot beverages. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or full-color wraps for a polished look that stands up to daily use.
